name: Redirect Primal Magic (Su)
body:
If the arcanist triggers a primal magic event, she can spend 1 point from her arcane reservoir as an immediate action to redirect the event. The event occurs at a location of the arcanist’s choosing within a 20-foot radius.

This radius expands by 5 feet for every 2 arcanist levels she has.
